source_snapshot.procedure: Enable EDKII/WHEA controls, boot Windows, halt with ITP, capture pcie.topology()/port_map(), select an unresolved socket/port for each PCIe slot, inject errType='ce' and resume.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains normal, BMC and optional UEFI may record a PCIe correctable error, and the front-panel fault light remains off.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Its EDAC/memory grep is mismatched to PCIe AER/WHEA and does not prove the selected physical slot or device remained healthy.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires topology mapping, but leaves the source's optional BMC/UEFI criteria without a mandatory primary PCIe CE oracle.
historical_reviews.related_cases: OCP CE, slot/OCP UCE, CTO/DPC and PCH cases must remain separate; a generic corrected event cannot satisfy them all.
historical_reviews.v3_1: PCIe indexes and ports are not stable identities; map BDF/root port/physical slot and active workload before injection.

original_test_intent: For every approved PCIe slot, inject one correctable PCIe error into the mapped root port and prove the intended AER/WHEA event occurs without link loss, device impairment, service disruption or fault-light assertion.
original_method: The FAE reconciles physical slot, endpoint BDF, root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port using fresh topology captures, confirms the endpoint is idle or safely testable, performs one CE injection, and correlates Cscript status with Windows/AER, link/device health and applicable management logs before restoration.
manual_activity: The FAE/operator approves the physical/logical slot map, quiesces the endpoint, changes BIOS controls, injects one CE and restores settings. The agent may validate mapping and collect read-only link, AER/WHEA and management evidence.
required_inputs: PCIe slot 1~N to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port map
Endpoint identity, driver/FW, active-use assessment and safe coverage list
Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and injectPcieError CE semantics
Mandatory Windows/AER/WHEA status plus applicable BMC/UEFI and link/device health oracle
Abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated or quiesced endpoint with no management-path dependency
Fresh topology/port map; never infer socket/port from numbering
One CE injection per approved slot with before/after link and driver health
Abort on wrong target, link retrain/down, device reset, fatal escalation or service impact
No automatic retry; restore settings and verify every affected endpoint
agent_execution_scope: Compare physical/logical topology and collect read-only Cscript, Windows/AER, link, driver, BMC/UEFI evidence
Do not select ports, change BIOS, inject, reset/retry or determine PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Define mandatory PCIe CE and optional management-log acceptance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: EDAC and memory-error grep patterns do not establish a PCIe correctable AER event; Linux dmesg conflicts with Windows and SSH trust is weakened.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use `injectPcieError(..., errType='ce')` only after a current topology proves the root port and physical slot. Collect the platform-native Windows WHEA/AER and Cscript status rather than memory EDAC keywords.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PCIe slot 1~N, CE severity, topology/port-map steps and 15/5-minute estimates are preserved; no slot/port is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot topology, BDF/link speed-width, driver state and counters; inject one mapped root port; time-correlate Cscript and Windows PCIe CE; verify unchanged link/device/service health and indicators; restore/diff BIOS state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Creates a deterministic PCIe-specific oracle despite optional BMC/UEFI logging.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic corrected or EDAC message neither proves PCIe CE delivery nor identifies the tested slot.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong port can affect a GPU, NIC, storage or management device and cause link loss or workload interruption.

project_override_considerations: The source's `may record` language cannot make every event optional. The approved Windows/Cscript PCIe-correctable evidence must be mandatory; BMC/UEFI applicability can remain platform-dependent.
expected_evidence: Endpoint identity, active-use precheck and package hash
Windows WHEA/AER PCIe CE plus link/device/driver health and applicable BMC/UEFI records
Front-panel off, settings restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Slot 1~N has no physical-to-socket/port/BDF map or coverage list; BMC/UEFI logs are merely optional without another explicit primary event signature; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and DeepSeek looks for memory EDAC instead of PCIe AER evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PCIe CE purpose and injector are identifiable. A platform map, package contract and PCIe-specific oracle can safely resolve execution.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 30 Wistron-System RAS-00750-V003: approve PCIe slot 1~N to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port coverage, ITP/CScripts version/hash and CE semantics; define mandatory Windows WHEA/AER/Cscript event signature when BMC/UEFI are optional, allowable link/device effects, endpoint quiesce rules, recovery and BIOS restoration.

review_improvement: Replaces a memory-EDAC grep with a PCIe-specific mapping and AER/WHEA oracle, preventing a corrected event from the wrong subsystem or slot from counting.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Cscript port number is not a durable physical-slot identity, and PCIe CE acceptance cannot be based on memory EDAC keywords. Each injection needs a fresh chain from slot label to endpoint BDF, root-port BDF and package socket/port. Because the source makes management logging optional, Cscript success plus Windows PCIe AER/WHEA and unchanged endpoint/link health must be the mandatory core. These project inputs are obtainable, so the case is RPUC with a source conflict rather than BLOCKED.
